entries.title: Flocking Spheres with Simple Neighbor Rules
entries.description: A cloud of colored spheres flies through 3D space following simple “boids” rules (alignment, cohesion, separation), leaving faint motion trails as they spontaneously form and dissolve flocks around a few stationary transparent beacons.
